user.title: Citycom MV account
user.description: Citycom requires a verification code on every login, and a login lasts 10 hours. The integration requests the code by email and reads it from your mailbox over IMAP, so it can log in again on its own. For Gmail, enable 2-Step Verification and create an App Password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.

data.imap_username: Email address the codes are sent to

code.title: Enter the verification code
code.description: No email from {sender} with a code arrived in {mailbox}. Enter the code from the email (or SMS) yourself. Check that the mail folder setting is right, or later logins will fail too.

progress.wait_for_email: Logging in to Citycom and waiting for the verification code email. This can take up to 2 minutes.
